verdict.rationale: Data storage location is a fair privacy question for an operating system with cloud-synced features, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents letting a user choose a storage region or data residency. The built-in protection tools mention (password management, private browsing) is an adjacent privacy feature, not residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
